memory_files.note: Each rule file needs frontmatter with a trigger (always_on, model_decision, glob or manual); files without it are ignored.
Loaded for the folder of every file the agent reads or edits, up to the workspace root.

notes: The global hooks file is shared by the agy CLI, the desktop app and the IDE, so one install covers all three. Workspace hooks load only in trusted folders.
A PreToolUse hook that crashes, times out or exits non-zero blocks the call (reported from testing with agy 1.1.21, not documented).
MCP tools appear under their own names, without the server, so MCP calls are classified as other.
Hooks run with only allowed environment variables; privometry-hook finds the home folder from the account database when HOME is missing.

trust.instructions: Open Codex, run /hooks and trust the Privometry hook once.

notes: Codex hooks fail open on crash or timeout and cannot ask; Privometry sends deny with a message for ask verdicts.
Hosted tools such as web search are not hookable.

memory_files.note: Path-specific instructions; applyTo frontmatter says which files they cover.

notes: preToolUse hooks fail closed when they crash or exit non-zero, but open when they time out. Ask is treated as deny in autopilot mode and by the cloud agent.
MCP tool names are not documented, so MCP calls are classified as other until payloads are recorded.
Copilot also runs the hooks in a repository's .claude/settings.json; Privometry installs Claude Code's hook at user scope, which Copilot does not read.
beforeReadFile payloads include file content; the hook client must never log or forward it.
Cursor also runs Claude Code hooks by default; the daemon dedupes using payload_markers.

memory_files.note: Global context; the save_memory tool appends facts under "## Gemini Added Memories".
Read from the working folder up to the project root and below it; context.fileName in settings can name other files (such as AGENTS.md).

notes: Gemini CLI hooks cannot ask, and fail open when a hook crashes, times out or prints something other than JSON; Privometry sends deny with a message for ask verdicts.
web_fetch takes a prompt that contains the URLs, so fetches carry no URL target.
Gemini CLI was retired for consumer tiers on 2026-06-18 in favor of Antigravity CLI; it stays available with Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses and paid API keys.
